description: This file defines a utility enum VoiceOverlayTextFormatting with static methods for processing and formatting overlay text in a voice interface, including computing text deltas and creating attributed strings for display.

classes.name: VoiceOverlayTextFormatting
classes.description: A utility enum providing static methods for text delta computation and attributed string creation for voice overlay UI.

methods.name: delta(after:committed:current:)
methods.description: Computes and returns the delta between a committed string and the current string if the current starts with the committed text. Otherwise, returns the current string.

methods.name: makeAttributed(committed:volatile:isFinal:)
methods.description: Creates and returns an NSAttributedString combining committed and volatile text with appropriate styling, based on whether the text is final.
